mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return in periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 10.0%, it indicates a severe labor market downturn that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 10.0, or the average 5-day return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in non-farm payroll employment signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery phases, a sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 600 thousand units signals strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day return in periods with HOUST > 600 is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05), or the Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor falls below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, it indicates accelerating inflation that prompts central bank tightening and reduces real equity returns, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day return in periods with CPIAUCSL 12m change > 2.5% is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or the Rank IC for the CPIAUCSL signal falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level (HOUST) above 600 thousand units signals robust residential construction activity and strong consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 60% of instances when HOUST > 600, or the Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor is below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90 (index, 2017=100), it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day return in periods with INDPRO < 90 is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or the Rank IC for INDPRO falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in housing starts (HOUST) and positive GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a broad-based economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and positive GDPC1 fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
